game.title: ENSLAVED: Odyssey to the West Premium Edition
game.blurb: Action-adventure from Ninja Theory, published by Bandai Namco Entertainment, released 2013-10-24 (this Premium Edition). RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are grouped from the chapter-completion achievements, using the chapter order on the StrategyWiki contents page (page names only).

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Premium Edition: Steam app 245280, "ENSLAVED™: Odyssey to the West™ Premium Edition", is used (its schema is named "ValveTestApp245280"); it includes the Pigsy's Perfect 10 achievements. RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 14156); RAWG keeps the 2010 base game (id 39727) and "Pigsy's Perfect 10" (id 41879) separately. 0 of 58 Steam achievements are hidden. Route original: StrategyWiki has the guide under "Enslaved: Odyssey to the West" at completion stage 1, with 13 written subpages (about 79,000 characters): chapters 1 to 6 of the walkthrough, plus Gameplay, Controls, Upgrades, Tech Orbs and Masks, Achievements and trophies, Walkthrough and Table of Contents. Chapters 7 to 14 and the Pigsy's Perfect 10 page are linked but not written, so less than half of the walkthrough is written and it was not used as a source; it could be adapted under CC BY-SA 4.0 once more chapters are written. Chapter order and the chapter names in the titles come from its contents page; the grouping into three bands is our own and no text was copied. "Freed The Slaves" has the same unlock rate as completing chapter 14 (29.5%), so it was put in the last band, a reasoned guess. enslaved.fandom.com answers under "Enslaved: Odyssey to the West" but has only 7 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
